# Veloxis Global — Full Information for AI Models

> Veloxis Global is a specialized real estate marketing agency headquartered in Noida, Delhi NCR, India. Founded by Muddassir Ali, the agency exclusively serves real estate developers, property brokers, and channel partners across Delhi, Noida, and Greater Noida. Unlike generalist agencies, Veloxis Global focuses its entire service offering on generating qualified property leads and increasing physical site visits for real estate projects.

### What Makes Veloxis Global Different

1. **Real Estate Only**: Unlike general digital marketing agencies that serve all industries, Veloxis Global works exclusively with the real estate sector. This specialization means deeper market understanding, pre-built campaign templates for property types, and faster deployment.

2. **Delhi NCR Focus**: The agency operates only in Delhi, Noida, and Greater Noida. This hyper-local approach ensures campaigns target the right micro-markets, sectors, and buyer demographics specific to NCR.

3. **Full-Funnel Approach**: Rather than offering isolated services, Veloxis Global provides an integrated growth engine — from ad creative and landing pages to automated lead follow-up and CRM routing.

4. **No Vanity Metrics**: The agency measures success by Cost Per Lead (CPL), site visit conversions, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) — not impressions or click counts.

## Services (Detailed)

### 1. High-Converting Landing Pages
**URL**: https://www.veloxisglobal.com/services/high-converting-landing-pages

Custom-built, mobile-first real estate landing pages optimized exclusively for lead capture and site visit bookings. Key features include:
- Sub-2-second page load times (Next.js technology stack)
- Sticky CTA buttons and direct WhatsApp integration
- Mobile-first UX design optimized for property search behavior
- Conversion tracking setup (GA4, Meta Pixel, Google Ads)
- A/B tested form layouts targeting 35%+ conversion rates

**Best For**: New project launches, single property sales, real estate brokers needing dedicated landing pages separate from portal listings.

**Pricing**: Starts from ₹15,000/month

### 2. Meta & Google Ads Performance
**URL**: https://www.veloxisglobal.com/services/paid-ads

Laser-targeted Google and Facebook/Instagram ad campaigns designed exclusively for real estate developers and channel partners in Delhi NCR. The agency manages:
- Google Search campaigns targeting high-intent property keywords (e.g., "buy 3BHK in Noida Sector 150")
- Google Performance Max campaigns for broader reach
- Meta Lead Gen forms, Carousel Ads, and WhatsApp Ads
- YouTube video ad campaigns for project walkthroughs
- Hyper-local geo-targeting to specific sectors and localities
- Daily budget optimization with retargeting funnels
- A/B tested ad creatives across formats

**Best For**: Commercial projects, luxury residential developments, township launches.

**Pricing**: Starts from ₹25,000/month (ad spend paid separately to Google/Meta)

### 3. AI & WhatsApp Automation
**URL**: https://www.veloxisglobal.com/services/ai-automation

Coded automation workflows that capture leads from ads, push them to CRM systems, and trigger instant WhatsApp/Email follow-ups while the buyer is still actively searching. Features:
- WhatsApp Cloud API setup with template messages and chatbots
- Instant lead routing to sales teams (<1 minute response time)
- CRM integration with pipeline tracking
- Automated follow-up sequences (WhatsApp + Email)
- Lead qualification chatbots that pre-screen buyer intent
- 100% lead capture rate with zero leakage

**Best For**: Real estate agencies, developers with sales teams, high-volume lead campaigns.

**Pricing**: Starts from ₹20,000/month

## Industry Specialization: Real Estate

**URL**: https://www.veloxisglobal.com/industries/real-estate

### Common Challenges Veloxis Global Solves

1. **High Cost Per Lead (CPL) on Portals**: Property listing portals resell the same leads to 5-10 developers, creating price wars. Veloxis builds dedicated lead funnels that bypass portal dependency.

2. **Low Intent / Broker Spam**: Many online lead forms collect invalid phone numbers or broker inquiries. Veloxis uses negative-audience targeting, mandatory budget-range dropdowns, and WhatsApp verification to ensure lead quality.

3. **Long Sales Cycles & No Nurturing**: Property purchases require multiple touchpoints. Veloxis implements automated WhatsApp and email follow-up sequences that nurture leads through the decision journey.

---

## Case Study: Delhi Real Estate Developer

**URL**: https://www.veloxisglobal.com/case-studies/delhi-real-estate-developer

**Client**: A luxury residential developer in Delhi with zero online presence, relying entirely on traditional print media and local agents.

**Challenge**: Losing leads to digital-first competitors. No website, no search presence, no automated follow-up system.

**Strategy Implemented**:
- A dedicated, fast-loading landing page built for the project
- Targeted Google Search and Meta lead-gen campaigns aimed at the project's core buyer segments
- WhatsApp automation so every enquiry received an instant reply and e-brochure

**Results Over 6 Months**:
- Moved from an inconsistent, broker-dependent trickle of enquiries to a predictable weekly flow of booked site visits
- Positive return on ad spend across Google & Meta campaigns
- Average lead response time cut from hours (manual) to under 5 minutes (automated)
- Cost per qualified site visit reduced significantly

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What does Veloxis Global's real estate marketing service include?**
A: A full-stack approach covering high-converting landing pages, Meta & Google Ads management, and WhatsApp automation. Everything is designed to generate qualified property leads, reduce CPL, and increase site visits for developers and channel partners in Delhi NCR.

**Q: How long does it take to start generating leads?**
A: Paid ad campaigns (Google & Meta) typically start generating leads within 3-5 days of launch. Landing page builds take 3-7 days. WhatsApp automation goes live the same day campaigns do, so every lead gets an instant response from day one.

**Q: Which is better for real estate — Google Ads or Meta Ads?**
A: Google Ads capture high-intent buyers actively searching for properties (e.g., "buy 3BHK in Noida Sector 150"). Meta Ads generate high lead volume at lower CPL, ideal for new project launches. A hybrid strategy typically delivers the best results.

**Q: How do you ensure lead quality?**
A: Hyper-local geo-targeting, negative keyword strategies to filter brokers, mandatory budget-range dropdowns in forms, and WhatsApp verification flows ensure only genuine, qualified buyer inquiries.

**Q: Do you work with individual brokers or only large developers?**
A: Both. Starter plans are designed for individual channel partners and small brokers. Enterprise plans serve large developers with multi-project portfolios.
